title: fix(objectql)!: a multi-row insert counts its earlier rows into the parent summary a field-level parent. predicate reads
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9CEK3WVYUqxMjpD1xegmPGF)_

Fixes #34466

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — skills/** teaches the parent. predicate (objectstack-formula SKILL.md, parent.status) but says nothing on how a multi-row insert reads a parent summary

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：一次插入多行明细时，明细字段上读父记录汇总的 `requiredWhen`（例如 `parent.line_count >= 2`）现在把同批前面已通过的行算进汇总，和一行一行插入的结果一致；导入的试运行（预览）也一样。
- 为什么改：#25579 已裁「批量等于逐条」，当时只覆盖了通过引用读父记录汇总的校验规则，读 `parent.` 的字段级条件仍按批前的值判断，同一批三条空描述的明细会全部通过，逐条插入时第三条会被拒。
- 风险与回滚：收窄（BREAKING）：今天一次批量能写进去的某些行，修后会被拒（只影响用 `parent.汇总字段` 写 `requiredWhen` 的明细对象，hotcrm 与示例应用里没找到）。读非汇总字段的条件（如 `parent.status`）、单行插入、更新都不变。回滚即撤回本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/summary-batch-accumulation.ts`（新增 `overlayRow`）、`packages/objectql/src/engine-insert.ts`（`insertParentOf`）、`packages/objectql/src/summary-rollup.test.ts`（末尾 #34466 一组）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/summary-rollup.test.ts`，预期全过；其中 #34466 一组 7 条，去掉修复后 3 条变红。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（需契约档 L2 审核记录）。

## What changes

A multi-row insert reads the master-detail header once for the whole batch (`resolveMasterDetailParents`, for a detail object that declares a `parent`-scoped `requiredWhen`). Since #25579 the rows the rules admit are accumulated in memory and overlaid on the related binding a validation rule reads through a reference; the header a field-level `parent.` predicate reads was not overlaid, so every row judged `parent.SUMMARY` as it stood before the batch. #25579's dev report named this as outside its card.

- `packages/objectql/src/summary-batch-accumulation.ts` — `BatchSummaryAccumulator.overlayRow(object, row)`: the same overlay for one stored row of the roll-up's parent object (a copy; an unbound header, `null` or `undefined`, is returned as it is). `overlay()` now shares its per-row body (`patchRow`); its behaviour does not move.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-insert.ts` — the validation loop binds `parent` through `insertParentOf`, which overlays the header when the batch has an accumulator and the object has one master-detail relation.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-validate.ts` — the multi-row insert preview binds `parent` the same way, so the import's dry run answers what the commit does (#25579 changed the preview and the write together). Added to the claim's file surface by the area (comment on #34466).
- `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx` — one sentence in the bulk-create paragraph: a detail object's `requiredWhen` reading the summary on `parent` reads it the same way.
- `.changeset/34466-batch-insert-parent-summary-predicate.md` — `patch` on `@objectstack/objectql`, BREAKING, FROM → TO and the one-line fix, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

The "Done when" fork of the card: the predicate analysis does name the field it reads (`summary-rule-reads.ts`, class (ii), landed with #34439), so this PR makes the insert equal one-by-one; no docs limit is written.

## Why

Ruling 6377847361 (letter C, 「批量等于逐条，并发不保证」) and ruling record 6928862195 (B, 「被规则读到的合计不延后」): a rule's answer inside one batch is the answer one-by-one writes give. With `requiredWhen: 'parent.line_count >= 2'` on `description`, three bare lines inserted one at a time admit two and refuse the third; inserted in one batch they were all admitted.

What narrows, named in the changeset: such a batch now refuses the row one-by-one inserts refuse (`insert(array)` refuses the whole batch; `insertMany` reports that row `ok: false`). Not moved: a `parent.` predicate reading a field that is no summary (`parent.status`), a single-row insert, an update, an unbound header, an `avg` summary (it keeps reading the stored value, as on the reference arm).

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/summary-rollup.test.ts` — a new top-level `describe` (#34466) on the file's memory driver, where the roll-up recompute runs for real: the one-by-one reference answer; `insert(array)` refuses with `VALIDATION_FAILED` / 400 / `description: required` and writes nothing; `insertMany` lands the first two and reports the third; a refused row is not counted; two headers in one batch count separately; CONTROL `parent.status` answers as before (draft admits, sent refuses on `note`); the multi-row preview answers `[true, true, false]`.
- `packages/objectql/src/summary-batch-accumulation.test.ts` — `overlayRow` moves the summary on a copy; leaves an unbound header, another parent id, another object and a header not handed the summary as they were.

Ablation (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, one mutation): `overlayRow`'s `return (patchRow(object, row) as R | undefined) ?? row;` replaced with `return row;` (anchor x1 → x0, blob `6d5e97b4ab77` → `e61da8f1f2ce`). These suites import the engine from source, so no rebuild. Result: `Tests 4 failed | 82 passed (86)` — red: `insert(array)`, `insertMany`, the preview, and the `overlayRow` unit pin; green as predicted: one-by-one, refused-row, two-headers, CONTROL and the "leaves as it was" unit pin. Restore: blob `6d5e97b4ab77` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- PR #34503 (#34412, same area, still open) edits call-site comments in `engine-insert.ts`: `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head against its head `ea224164` is clean.
- Hooks and flow steps still read the pre-batch header inside one batch, as ruling record 6928862195 states for both doors.
- The sibling #34465 (a predicate update, `multi: true`) is not touched here; it follows in its own PR.
